summary: The Battle of The Ford: Suvarna defeated Giridurga; 240 fell.
The Suvarna host carried the field after 5 minutes: their foes broke and fled.
Suvarna losses: 93 killed, 29 taken. Giridurga losses: 147 killed, 7 taken.
32 Giridurga men were cut down or taken in the rout.
outcome.chronicle: The Battle of The Ford: Suvarna defeated Giridurga; 240 fell.
